blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipal government of Santo Domingo in this province will shift to a four-day onsite workweek starting Monday, Oct. 5. This is part of efforts to conserve energy, promote environmental sustainability, and improve administrative efficiency. Under the interim modified workweek, municipal offices will operate onsite from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Thursday, while employees will work from home every Friday. The local government said in an advisory Friday (Oct. 2) that the arrangement was adopted to reduce energy consumption and support more sustainable and efficient government operations.
